reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text:
This app failed to deliver the functionality it advertised. From the beginning, it would not perform basic tasks such as displaying tire pressure information or providing vehicle location mapping. Whenever I attempted to refresh the app to obtain updated vehicle data, I frequently received an error message stating that my vehicle was unable to perform the requested task.

In addition, I was constantly required to log back into the app, and on multiple occasions it created duplicate entries for my vehicle. The overall experience was frustrating and unreliable.

I use the app with a 2024 Hyundai Palisade, and unfortunately it never consistently performed even the most basic functions. To make matters worse, despite these ongoing issues, the Apple App Store denied my refund request. I am very disappointed with both the app’s performance and the lack of customer support regarding a refund.

reviews.title: No refund available
reviews.text: Since this app is linked to a service provided by the car manufacturer, it’s not available for vehicles for which the manufacturer has discontinued that service. If I had known that beforehand, I wouldn’t have downloaded it. What’s more, I only found out after I had already paid. And there’s no way to know that in advance. So, I contacted support and requested a refund. I provided my VIN and a screenshot of the error three times, but I got the same response every time. “Hello, Thanks for reaching customer support. Unfortunately, I’m busy at the moment. If you encountered any bugs, please share the error screenshots and vehicle VIN. I’ll get back within 48 hours. Thanks for your patience. Julia - Customer Support.” It’s ridiculous to keep going through the same thing over and over, so I’ve given up and accepted that this company has no intention of issuing a refund.
